Who We Are

Building Futures Through Skills & Community

"Development is not a destination — it is a continuous investment in people. When young people are skilled and supported, entire communities rise."

Founded in 2026 in Nigeria, Community Youth & Skills Development Society Inc was built on one conviction: that every young person — regardless of background, ability, or circumstance — deserves access to the tools and support needed to build a meaningful future.


In 2025, we expanded to Nigeria to serve newcomer youth and immigrant families navigating the challenges of starting over in a new country. Our mission is focused on serving communities across Nigeria.

Where We Work

Our Programs

Two countries. One purpose. Equipping youth and families with what they need to stand on their own.

🇳🇬
Nigeria
Established 2026

We work directly with youth and young adults across Nigeria to unlock potential and create clear pathways into productive, sustainable futures.

  • Vocational and technical skills training for unemployed and underemployed youth
  • Digital literacy and technology education
  • Entrepreneurship development and small business mentorship
  • Life skills coaching — leadership, communication, and financial literacy
  • Inclusive skills programs for youth living with disabilities
  • Internship, employment, and startup connection programs
🇳🇬
Nigeria
Expanded 2025

Across Nigeria, we stand beside young people and families as they build stronger futures — providing practical support, skills, mentorship, and opportunities.

  • Vocational skills training and practical development resources
  • Career counseling and professional development support
  • Mentorship connecting young people with experienced community members
  • Digital and workplace readiness training
  • Youth support and community referrals
  • Youth leadership and community development programs
  • Community resources and financial literacy guidance
🎯

Our Mission

To equip youth and newcomer families with the skills, mentorship, and resources they need to build independent, dignified, and prosperous lives — across Nigeria and wherever our communities reach.

🌎

Our Vision

  • Every young person has access to skills that open real doors
  • Every newcomer is empowered to rebuild and contribute confidently
  • Every community benefits from the full potential of its people
💡

Our Approach

We don't just offer information — we walk alongside people. From skills training to mentorship, from settlement resources to entrepreneurship support, we provide hands-on, community-centered development that creates lasting change.

Why We Exist

The Challenge We're Answering

In Nigeria, millions of young people graduate each year without clear pathways into meaningful work.

The challenges look different — but the solution is the same: targeted skills development, genuine mentorship, and a community that refuses to leave anyone behind.

Community Youth & Skills Development Society Inc exists at that intersection. Across Nigeria, our commitment remains unchanged.

To develop. To equip. To empower.
Built for impact

Clear focus. Community-led action.

Our work is centered on practical pathways that help young Nigerians build skills, confidence and access to opportunity.

🎓

Youth Skills

Vocational training, digital literacy and practical learning designed around real-world capability.

💻

Technology

Digital skills and technology exposure that support learning, creativity and economic participation.

🤝

Community

Mentorship, entrepreneurship and community development initiatives delivered with local needs in mind.

Established in Nigeria in 2026. Operating areas include Lagos, Abuja and communities across Nigeria.

Meet The Founder

C.O Alfred

"Every young Nigerian carries the seed of greatness. Our job is simply to give it the right soil to grow."

C.O Alfred is the Founder and Executive Director of Community Youth & Skills Development Society Inc, established in Nigeria in 2026. Driven by a lifelong passion for youth empowerment and community development, Alfred founded the organisation to address the widening gap between Nigeria's growing youth population and access to meaningful skills and opportunities.

With deep roots in Nigerian communities, Alfred leads the organisation's programs across vocational training, digital literacy, entrepreneurship, and mentorship — building pathways that transform young lives from the ground up.
